title: Building AI Skills
text:
Getting comfortable with AI doesn't require becoming a technologist — just enough working understanding to direct these tools with judgment and evaluate their output critically.

The most efficient starting point isn't the most advanced course; it's exploring the tools already available to you, like Microsoft Copilot through Microsoft Learn's free, guided paths.

From there, structured paths exist at beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels, covering prompt engineering, institutional tools, and pedagogical frameworks.
